activityPrivacyDescription: Manage game activity sharing with friends and people in selected servers.
activityPrivacyWaiting: Account preferences are not ready yet. These controls are disabled to protect your current account.

activityPrivacyNoServers: You have not joined any servers yet.
registeredGamesDescription: Register Windows game executables on this device to see whether they are running and when they were last detected. By default, checks run only while this page is open. You can separately opt in to local checks while HiChat is running; this is not foreground or gameplay tracking. Paths and process data stay on this device.
registeredGamesBackgroundDetection: Check registered games in the background
registeredGamesBackgroundDetectionDescri: Off by default. When enabled, only registered executables are checked about every 30 seconds while the app runs. Paths stay on this device. A game ID and name are sent only when both per-game consent and account activity sharing are also enabled.
registeredGamesWebUnsupported: Local game detection is available only in the HiChat Windows desktop app. This browser cannot inspect running processes.
registeredGamesUnsupported: Registered-game detection is not available on this operating system.
registeredGamesUnavailable: HiChat could not read the local process list. Your saved registrations are unchanged.
registeredGamesFileRecovery: This registration is kept. Remove it and add the executable again after restoring or choosing its file.
registeredGamesNoCurrent: No registered game is currently detected as running.
registeredGamesRemoveConfirm: Remove this game from this device’s local registry?
registeredGamesShare: Allow sharing this game’s public name
registeredGamesOverlayOptIn: Allow the voice widget over this game's foreground window
registeredGamesOverlayDescription: Local opt-in only. Applies in Game overlay mode while the global voice-widget switch is enabled. It does not require background scanning or game-activity sharing, and does not guarantee fullscreen compatibility or approval by anti-cheat software.
registeredGamesOverlaySupportAvailable: The bundled helper is present, but foreground overlay runtime compatibility has not been verified. This checkbox records local permission only; it does not mean the overlay is running.
registeredGamesOverlaySupportUnavailable: The bundled helper is unavailable in this installation. You can save this local permission for a future packaged helper, but the game overlay is unavailable here.
registeredGamesOverlaySupportUnsupported: Game-window overlay is unsupported on this platform. The checkbox records local permission only and will not enable an overlay here.
registeredGamesOverlaySupportUnknown: Overlay support status is unknown. Treat this checkbox as a local permission only; runtime support has not been verified.
registeredGamesReportIssueDescription: Issues use the standard feedback form. No executable path, screenshot, duration, or process details are collected or attached automatically; any files you attach are your choice.
registeredGamesShareNotice: Per-game consent stays on this device. Sharing also requires background detection and account consent in Game Activity Privacy. Only the selected game's ID and name are sent, never executable paths.
registeredGamesLoadError: Could not load local game registrations.
registeredGamesSaveError: Could not update the local game registry.

emailCampaignValidation: Choose a category, a subject (up to 120 characters), a message (up to 10,000 characters), and an expiry between one hour and thirty days from now.
emailCampaignProviderNotice: Publishing queues jobs only. A configured provider, current verified address, consent and unexpired campaign are required before delivery.

sessions.title: Signed-in sessions
sessions.description: These are real sign-ins, not verified physical devices. Client details are self-reported. Ending a session blocks its API, refresh, private media and chat connection; other sign-ins stay active.
sessions.loadError: Sessions could not be loaded. Refresh or sign in again.
sessions.factorHint: If two-step verification is enabled, enter a fresh authenticator code or unused recovery code. Otherwise leave this blank.
sessions.factorRequired: Enter your authenticator or recovery code to end sessions.
sessions.confirmSelf: End this session and return to sign-in?
sessions.confirmOne: End this sign-in? Its connections will lose access. Other sessions are not ended.
sessions.confirmOthers: End every other sign-in while keeping this session?
sessions.revokeError: The session change could not be confirmed. Check your password and refresh before retrying; a timed-out request may have completed.
sessions.empty: No active sessions found. Refresh or sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Use an authenticator app and keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. Existing sessions stay signed in; end them separately if needed.
mfa.setupInstructions: In your authenticator, add an account manually: HiChat, time-based, SHA-1, 6 digits, 30 seconds. Enter this setup key, then the current code below.
mfa.setupExpiry: Setup expires after 10 minutes. The key is shown only during this setup. Never share it.
mfa.saveCodes: Save these codes now. They will not be shown again. Each works once instead of an authenticator code. Regenerating replaces all previous recovery codes.
mfa.disableWarning: This removes the authenticator and invalidates every recovery code. Password-only login will be possible.
mfa.loadError: Security status could not be loaded. Retry before changing anything.
mfa.operationError: Security change could not be confirmed. Check your password and refresh the status before retrying; a timed-out request may have completed.
mfa.invalid: Invalid, expired or already used code. Wait for a new authenticator code or use an unused recovery code.
mfa.rateLimited: Too many security attempts. Wait five minutes and try again.

voiceOverlayDesc: Controls the passive desktop widget on the primary display. It is not attached to or aware of a game window; the preview below is visual only.
voiceOverlayGameModeDesc: Show the widget only over foreground windows for games opted in below. The global voice-widget switch must also be enabled. This is local only: it does not require background scanning or game-activity sharing, and does not guarantee fullscreen compatibility or anti-cheat approval.
voiceOverlayPreviewDescription: See how the current voice-widget settings look. The sample does not represent people in your call.
voiceOverlayMaxParticipantsLabel: Maximum participants shown in the widget
voiceOverlayDesktopOnly: The live voice widget is available only in the desktop app. This settings preview is local and does not start the overlay.
voiceOverlayPinnedDesc: When pinned, the movement shortcut cannot unlock dragging. The overlay is already shown above other windows; this preference is stored on this device.
voiceOverlayResetUnsupported: Resetting the native widget layout is available only in the desktop app.
voiceOverlayResetFailed: The widget layout could not be reset. Your current position and scale were kept.
voiceOverlayResetSuccess: Widget layout reset. Other audio and media settings were unchanged.
voiceOverlayQuickActionsDesc: Device-local preference for native desktop overlay controls. These controls are unavailable on the web.
voiceOverlayClickableActions: Allow clicks on mute and deafen only
voiceOverlayClickableActionsDesc: When locked, only its mute and deafen buttons receive clicks; other areas pass clicks through. Button clicks are validated locally; no pointer history is recorded.
voiceOverlayActivityDesc: Shows only activity friends have already shared with you and that is visible here. It never reads this device's process list or invents game joins. Live activity display is supported by the Windows desktop overlay; the web preview does not show live activity.
voiceOverlayGoLiveDesc: Shows when the Windows game overlay actually opens, if the connected voice channel permits publishing and screen capture is supported. Does not start a stream.
voiceOverlayWelcomeDesc: Shows once when the supported native overlay actually becomes visible. Changing this preference in an open overlay does not create a notice.
voiceOverlayNotificationsDesc: Shows only genuine unread notification indicators in the read-only native desktop widget. No decrypted message text or preview is sent to the overlay; live notifications are not shown in the web preview.
voiceOverlayNotificationActions: Allow opening inbox from notification indicators
voiceOverlayNotificationActionsDesc: Opens your inbox. Eligible mention, reply, accepted direct-message and group-message notifications can prepare a reply to the exact message in the main chat; nothing is sent automatically and existing drafts are preserved. This is a separate device-only opt-in from mute/deafen clicks.
voiceOverlayChat: Show recent chat in the widget
voiceOverlayChatDesc: Optional read-only excerpt of up to five recent messages, stored only on this device. It is not a composer and cannot send replies. Available in the desktop widget only; the web preview does not show chat.
voiceOverlayChatActions: Allow opening chat in the app
voiceOverlayChatActionsDesc: Adds a separate, explicit Open chat button to the desktop widget and grants permission for focused chat actions. It asks the main app to open its current chat; the overlay sends no message text or destination ID and cannot reply. Device-local and off by default; unavailable on the web.
voiceOverlayChatCompose: Allow composing chat from the widget
voiceOverlayChatComposeDesc: Adds a separate button that opens a focused desktop composer. Requires Show recent chat and Allow opening chat in the app to be enabled as well. Messages are sent only after you press Send; drafts stay in memory and are discarded when the conversation or account changes or the composer closes. Failed delivery may be unknown, and is never retried automatically. Device-local and off by default; unavailable on the web.
acc.previewPresence: Online, idle, and do not disturb presence preview

acc.showDisplayNameStylesDesc: Enables display name styles, including font, effects, and color.

acc.messageStyleDesc: Change the appearance of chat messages.
acc.messageGroupGapDesc: Adjust the spacing between message groups.
acc.saturationDesc: Reduces saturation of colors in the app for those with color sensitivities. This setting does not affect saturation of images, videos, role colors, or other user content.
acc.saturateCustomDesc: Apply the above setting to custom color selections like Role Colors.
acc.disableAnimatedEmojiDesc: Show static frames instead of animated emoji.
acc.autoplayGifsDesc: When off, GIFs play only on hover.
acc.screenReaderNote: Tayfa works with common screen readers like NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver. All text labels and interactive elements have accessible names.
acc.notificationVolumeDesc: Adjust the loudness of new message and notification sounds.
acc.ttsEnabledDesc: Read incoming messages aloud using the browser's speech synthesis engine.
acc.syncReducedMotionDesc: Follow the operating system's reduced-motion preference and update while HiChat is open.
acc.notificationDurationDesc: Keep eligible notifications visible for at least this long.
acc.ttsPreviewText: This is a HiChat text-to-speech preview.
acc.stickerAnimationDesc: Choose when animated stickers are allowed to play.
acc.highContrastDesc: Increase text, border, and keyboard-focus contrast.
acc.syncHighContrastDesc: Follow forced-colors and increased-contrast system preferences.
acc.showSwitchIndicatorsDesc: Add check and cross symbols so switch state is not communicated by color alone.
acc.showImageDescriptionsDesc: Expose available attachment descriptions to screen readers and show them below images.
acc.legacyComposerDesc: Use the native screen-reader-friendly text area without rich picker popups.
acc.roleColorsDesc: Choose how member role colors appear in messages.
acc.officialMessagesDesc: Choose how verified HiChat application messages appear.
wallpaperDropHint: Click or drag an image here
wallpaperReplaceHint: Click or drop a new image to replace
wallpaperBadType: Unsupported file type (JPEG, PNG, or WebP only)
roleMentionableDesc: When enabled, anyone can mention this role in messages to notify all members.
confirmDeleteRole: Are you sure you want to delete the role "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
permManageRolesDesc: Create, edit, and delete roles below their highest role
permBanMembersDesc: Permanently ban members from the server
permManageMessagesDesc: Delete and edit other members' messages
permViewChannelDesc: Allows members to see this channel in the sidebar
permAdminDesc: Members with this permission have every permission and can bypass channel-specific overrides
permAdminWarning: This is a dangerous permission to grant!
defaultRoleWarning: This is the default role assigned to all members. It cannot be deleted.
noRoleSelected: Select a role to edit its settings
usernameHint: 3-32 characters. Letters, numbers, and underscores only.
avatarMaxSize: Max 8MB. JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF (animated GIFs play on hover).
dmPrivacyHint: Controls who can start a direct message conversation with you
profileBannerHint: Shown at the top of your profile card. Wide images work best (5:2); it is cropped from the centre.
profileBioPlaceholder: Tell people a little about yourself. Anyone who can see your profile can read this.
avatarAnimatedWebpUnsupported: Animated WebP is not supported. Please upload a GIF instead.
avatarAnimationReducedMotionNote: Reduce Motion is on, so animated avatars only play while you hover over them.
noPermission: You don't have permission to access this section
logOutConfirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
roleCannotEdit: You cannot edit roles at or above your level
ownerRoleWarning: This is the Owner role. It has full permissions and cannot be modified, deleted, or reordered.
ownerRoleEditHint: You can change the name and color of the Owner role. Permissions cannot be modified.
permMoveMembersDesc: Move members between voice channels and disconnect from voice
permMuteMembersDesc: Server mute members in voice channels
permDeafenMembersDesc: Server deafen members in voice channels
permManageInvitesDesc: Create, view, and delete invite links
permUseSoundboardDesc: Play sounds from the soundboard in voice channels
permManageSoundboardDesc: Add, edit, and delete sounds in the soundboard
permManageExpressionsDesc: Upload, rename, delete and copy the server's custom emojis and stickers
permUseEntranceSoundDesc: Have your entrance sound played when you join a voice channel
permManageApplicationsDesc: Install, configure, and revoke applications for this server
permManageEventsDesc: Create and manage events for this server
inviteRequiredDesc: When enabled, new members must provide an invite code to register
afkTimeoutDesc: Users inactive for this duration will be disconnected from voice channels.
livekitSettingsDesc: Manage the LiveKit connection for voice and video in this server.
livekitPlatformManaged: This server uses HiChat!'s voice infrastructure. No configuration needed.
livekitNoInstance: No voice server configured for this server.
pttKeyHint: Click and press a key to bind
pttWebOnly: Push to Talk only works while this tab is focused. Use the desktop app for global PTT support.
muteHotkeyDesc: Toggle your mic on/off with a keyboard shortcut
muteHotkeyHint: Click and press a key to bind. Modifier combinations (Ctrl/Shift/Alt) are not supported.
muteHotkeyFocusNote: Only works while this app window is focused.
muteHotkeyGlobalDesc: Works even when the HiChat window is not focused. While enabled, the desktop app watches this key system-wide. Pick a key you don't type in other apps.
muteHotkeyPttConflict: This key is also your push-to-talk key — push-to-talk wins while PTT mode is active.
noiseReductionDesc: The selected engine processes microphone audio on your device. Calls and the microphone test use the same noise reduction settings.
noiseReductionEngineDesc: All options are free. RNNoise is the lightweight default. DeepFilterNet3 provides strong suppression at 48 kHz. GTCRN and DTLN run at 16 kHz. SpeexDSP is a classic filter; WebRTC uses the browser's built-in suppression.
noiseSuppressionLevelDesc: Mutes low-energy audio after the engine. This setting does not change model suppression strength. Stricter thresholds can clip quiet speech. The gate also works when noise reduction is off.
nrNarrowbandCaveat: This model downsamples to 16 kHz. Detail above 8 kHz cannot be restored, so voices may sound muffled. Choose RNNoise or DeepFilterNet3 to keep a wider audio band.
gatePresetMaximum: Very strict — may clip quiet speech
gateBypassedDesc: The audio threshold filter is disabled for the music profile or 100% microphone sensitivity.
micTestPipelineDesc: The test uses your call's engine and audio threshold settings. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
micTestFailed: The microphone test could not start. Check microphone permission and your selected device, then try again.
microphoneUpdateFailed: The microphone setting could not be applied. The previous audio stream is still in use.
audioPipelineFallbackDesc: The selected engine could not start. Audio continues with the running processing shown above.
audioPipelineNoSuppressionDesc: Noise reduction could not be enabled on this device. Microphone audio continues; check the available processing shown above.
audioPipelineGainUnavailable: Microphone volume adjustment is unavailable on this audio path. Your saved volume setting is kept for supported processing.
audioPipelineDoubleSuppressionDesc: Browser noise reduction could not be turned off. The software model was skipped to avoid processing your voice twice.
audioPipelineErrorDesc: Audio processing could not start. Try restarting the microphone or test.
audioPipelineGateUnavailable: Gate: unavailable on this audio path
deepfilterSuppressionDesc: How aggressively the AI model removes noise (0-100). 0 = bypass, 100 = maximum suppression. The slider takes effect live — no need to restart the engine.
joinLeaveSoundsDesc: Play a sound when someone joins or leaves voice
screenShareShowCursorDesc: When on, the mouse cursor appears in the shared screen. Turn off to hide it from viewers.
screenShareAudioDesc: Share system audio when screen sharing (game, music). Voice chat audio is automatically excluded.
screenShareAudioDescBrowser: Share system audio when screen sharing. May cause echo in voice chat.
screenShareLowLatencyHint: Switches the codec from VP9 to H264. Lower encoder latency and smoother playback at the cost of some sharpness (especially on small text).
screenShareModeMotionHint: When bandwidth tightens, preserve frame rate and soften resolution. Ideal for gameplay and video — no stuttering, slightly softer image.
screenShareModeDetailHint: When bandwidth tightens, preserve resolution and drop frame rate. Ideal for slides, code and docs — text stays sharp, motion may stutter.
micProfileDesc: Sets the entire mic chain: capture constraints, noise suppression and Opus encoding. Switching republishes your mic for a moment — you don't need to leave the channel.
micProfileSpeechDesc: Mono, with echo cancellation and noise suppression on. The right choice for normal conversation.
micProfileMusicDesc: Stereo, with all voice processing off. For instruments, audio interfaces or a good condenser mic.
micProfileMusicWarning: Heads up: the Music profile turns off noise suppression, echo cancellation and automatic gain. On speakers the others will hear echo — use headphones.
cameraQualityDesc: Resolution of your published camera feed. Higher is sharper but needs more upload bandwidth.
cameraFpsDesc: 30 fps gives smooth motion. 15 fps spends the same bandwidth on fewer frames — less motion, sharper image.
cameraApplyHint: Device changes apply immediately in voice channels. Quality and FPS apply when you reopen the camera. In direct calls, all changes apply when you reopen the camera.
selectChannelToEdit: Select a channel to edit its permissions
selectRoleToEdit: Select a role to edit overrides
channelPermDesc: Override role permissions for this channel. Inherit uses the role's default setting.
themeDescription: Choose a color palette for the interface
blurDescription: Frosted glass effect on sidebar panels. Disable on low-end hardware if you notice stuttering.
blurDisabledInTransparent: Blur is unavailable while transparent background is on — a transparent Electron window cannot composite backdrop blur.
lightningDescription: Animated neon lightning bolts flash in the main panel. Disable on weak hardware.
neonDescription: Neon edge glow around the window. Off by default; turn on or adjust intensity here.
uiScaleDescription: Scale the whole interface - text, icons and spacing - like browser zoom. Handy on high-resolution displays.
transparentDescription: Make the window background transparent so your desktop shows through behind the panels.
transparentRestart: Restart the app to apply this change.
wallpaperDescription: Upload an image shown behind the frosted panels. Synced across your devices.
wallpaperTransparencyOverride: Wallpaper is hidden on this device while transparent background is enabled. Your account's wallpaper choice is preserved.
themeAuroraDesc: Deep space blue with northern lights green
themeMidnightDesc: Neutral dark gray with blue accent
themeCrispLightDesc: Bright day mode, clean and professional
themeObsidianRoseDesc: Luxurious dark theme with gold and rose accents

feedbackContentPlaceholder: Describe the issue, suggestion, or question in detail (min 10 characters)
feedbackEvidenceHint: Drop images here or click to browse
feedbackDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this feedback? This cannot be undone.

lifecycle.title: Disable account
lifecycle.description: Disabling ends all sign-ins and makes you offline. It does not delete messages, memberships, server ownership or profile data. To return, enter your credentials on the login page and explicitly choose to restore the account; enabled two-factor verification is still required. Resetting a password does not restore the account automatically.
lifecycle.confirm: All current sign-ins will end, including this one. Your data and owned servers remain. You can restore the account later with your credentials and an explicit restore confirmation.
lifecycle.error: The account could not be disabled. Check your current password and verification code, then retry.

verification.title: Verify email
verification.description: Only the current address can be verified. Links are single-use and expire after 20 minutes; changing or removing the address invalidates old links. This is separate from marketing preferences.
verification.loadError: Verification status could not be loaded. Refresh to check the current address.
verification.noEmail: Add an email address above first.
verification.unverified: This email address is not verified.
verification.unavailable: Email delivery is not configured on this server. A verification message cannot be sent yet.
verification.accepted: The email provider accepted the verification message. Check your inbox and spam folder; acceptance does not guarantee delivery.
verification.sendError: Sending was not confirmed. If a message arrives, its link may still work. Refresh status before retrying.
verification.changed: The address or verification state changed. Refresh before requesting a link.
verification.retryAfter_one: You can request another link in {{count}} second.
verification.retryAfter_other: You can request another link in {{count}} seconds.

ownership.title: Transfer server ownership
ownership.warning: The recipient becomes the server owner and can remove you or delete the server. Your ownership cannot be restored by this form. Existing ordinary roles and shared history remain unchanged.
ownership.loadError: Current ownership or members could not be verified. You may no longer own this server. Refresh before continuing.
ownership.eligibility: Only an active human member can receive ownership. The server checks bans, account status and hosted-server limits when the transfer commits.
ownership.consent: I understand that I am permanently giving up ownership of this server.
ownership.finalConfirm: Give ownership of {{server}} to {{target}} ({{id}})? They can remove you or delete the server. This form cannot undo the transfer.
ownership.success: Server ownership transferred. Your ordinary roles are unchanged.
ownership.error: The transfer was not confirmed. It may already have committed if the connection failed. Refresh ownership before retrying; do not assume you still own the server.
ownership.discard: Discard the transfer form and its entered credentials?

privacyControls.title: Data and privacy
privacyControls.essential: HiChat processes account, security, message-routing and abuse-prevention data required to provide the service. Required processing has no misleading off switch.
privacyControls.deleteLink: You can disable or delete your account below and manage active sessions in this page.
privacyControls.serverDMDefault: Allow direct messages from server members
privacyControls.serverDMDefaultHint: Applies to shared servers without an individual override.
privacyControls.serverDMOverrides: {{count}} servers have a custom DM permission.
privacyControls.serverOverrideActive: A custom permission is active for this server
privacyControls.friendRequests: Who can send you friend requests
privacyControls.friendRequestsHint: These rules are enforced by the server, including requests sent directly through the API.
privacyControls.personalizedFriendMessagesHint: When disabled, the friend-request form does not send an introduction message.
privacyControls.ignoredUsersHint: Ignored messages stay in history but are collapsed. Ignoring does not block messages, calls or friend requests.
privacyControls.noIgnoredUsers: No ignored users match this search.
privacyControls.profileAudienceHint: Friends can always view it. Other people must also match the selected shared-server rule.
privacyControls.profileAudienceSmall: People in shared servers with 200 members or fewer
privacyControls.profileUpdatesHint: Creates a new friend notification when you save a visible profile change. Turning this off does not discard profile edits.
privacyControls.shareOnlineUpdates: Notify friends when I become online
privacyControls.shareOnlineUpdatesHint: Friends who enable online notifications can receive an update when you come online.
privacyControls.shareStreamUpdates: Notify friends when I start screen sharing
privacyControls.shareStreamUpdatesHint: Off by default. Friends who enable stream notifications can be notified when you start sharing your screen.
privacyControls.personalization: Personalize suggestions from my profile and activity
privacyControls.personalizationHint: Allows optional profile completeness, server membership and friendship inputs to produce suggestions. Off by default; when off those inputs are not read for recommendations.
privacyControls.clipVoiceConsent: Allow my voice in locally recorded clips
privacyControls.clipVoiceConsentHint: Off by default. Recorders receive a consent roster; your microphone track is excluded while this is off and ongoing recorders refresh consent during recording.
privacyControls.telemetryHint: Allows aggregated screen-share performance events. Off by default; security and failure diagnostics remain active.

deletion.title: Delete account permanently
deletion.description: Your sign-ins, credentials and personal profile are removed. Shared messages and their attachments remain for other participants under a deleted identity. This cannot be undone or reactivated.
deletion.retention: Personal files no longer in use are queued for cleanup; shared files remain. Internal author IDs, text other people wrote, downloaded copies and existing backups are not retroactively erased by this action.
deletion.loadError: Deletion requirements could not be checked. Deletion stays unavailable until a fresh check succeeds.
deletion.admin: Hand off platform administration before deleting this account.
deletion.owned_one: You own {{count}} resource that must be handed off or removed first.
deletion.owned_zero: No ownership blockers were found at the last check.
deletion.owned_other: You own {{count}} resources that must be handed off or removed first.
deletion.handoff: Use the transfer form beside an owned server to hand it off. Transfer or remove owned applications separately, then refresh. Deleting your account does not delete these resources for you.
deletion.consent: I understand that this is permanent and shared history remains for other people.
deletion.finalConfirm: Permanently remove your account identity and sign-ins? Shared history remains. Personal file cleanup is queued, not guaranteed to finish immediately. This cannot be undone.
deletion.changed: Ownership or administration changed. Refresh and complete the required handoff before trying again.
deletion.error: Deletion was not confirmed. Do not assume it failed or succeeded: check whether you can still sign in and refresh before retrying. Deleted accounts cannot be reactivated.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Control access to object identifiers while developing and debugging.
developer.modeDescription: Shows copy ID actions in message, user, and other supported object menus.

performanceTrace.title: Capture performance trace
performanceTrace.description: Creates an up-to-30-second local performance recording with sensitive connection values scrubbed. It is written only to the file you choose.
performanceTrace.error: The performance trace could not be created.

dataExport.title: Export your personal data
dataExport.description: Prepares a JSON copy of your account details, preferences, memberships, and chat records you authored. Passwords, session keys, and MFA secrets are never exported.
dataExport.ready: Your export is ready to download.
dataExport.error: The export could not be prepared.
dataExport.downloadError: The export could not be downloaded or has expired.

accountStatus.title: Account status
accountStatus.description: Current platform status and active server bans/timeouts from moderation records. This is not a trust score, a report history, or a guarantee about pending reports. Refresh to check for changes.
accountStatus.loadError: Account status could not be checked. Any previously loaded records below may be out of date; try refreshing.
accountStatus.platformAllowed: No platform ban is recorded for this account.
accountStatus.platformBanned: This account has a platform ban.
accountStatus.none: No active server bans or timeouts were found at the last check.

profileShowcaseLoadError: Profile showcase could not be loaded
profileShowcaseSaveError: Profile showcase could not be saved
profileShowcaseConflict: This profile changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Review the latest version before choosing whether to overwrite it.
profileAllFree: All profile customization options are free.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.advancedDescription: Configure supported desktop delivery and text-to-speech options.
notifications.delayDesc: Wait briefly before showing an OS notification. Notifications with the same conversation tag are combined; items read during the delay are skipped. Sounds and incoming calls are not delayed.
notifications.backgroundLimits: HiChat must remain running (including in the Windows tray) to receive these notifications. A closed browser does not receive web push. The operating system controls how long its notification stays visible.

permission.default: Desktop permission has not been decided yet.
permission.denied: Desktop notifications are blocked by the browser or operating system.
permission.unsupported: Desktop notifications are unavailable on this platform.

notifications.desktopEnabledDesc: Show an operating-system notification while HiChat is in the background.
notifications.taskbarFlashDesc: Ask for attention when a new unmuted event arrives.
notifications.unreadBadgeDesc: Show the unread total on the taskbar, title, and browser icon.
notifications.focusedDesc: Also show desktop notifications while you are already using HiChat.
notifications.streamDesc: Notify when eligible friends start a stream.
notifications.onlineFriendsDesc: Notify when eligible friends come online.
notifications.profileUpdatesDesc: Notify when a friend shares a profile update.
notifications.upcomingEventsDesc: Notify 15 minutes before events you marked as interested in.
notifications.muteAllDesc: Silence notification and incoming-call cues without changing your other choices.
notifications.messageSoundDesc: Play a cue for an unmuted message.
notifications.currentChannelSoundDesc: Play a cue even while viewing that conversation.
notifications.emailDesc: Category mail is sent only to a verified address. Delivery support is implemented separately from security email.

emailCategories.communicationDesc: Missed calls, messages, and conversation summaries.
emailCategories.announcementsDesc: Product updates and important feature news.

notifications.unsubscribeDesc: Disable every optional email category in one step.
notifications.securityEmailNote: Security and account-protection emails are always separate from marketing preferences.

linkedGames.title: Messaging in connected games
linkedGames.description: Manage HiChat game applications you have authorized to send direct messages to you. An application can access the history of a direct conversation it participates in; this permission does not grant access to your other conversations or verify ownership of a profile link. Server and group permissions are managed separately.
linkedGames.authorizeConfirm: Allow {{name}} to send messages to you using its own application identity? Existing block and message-request rules still apply.
linkedGames.revokeConfirm: Revoke permission for {{name}} to send new direct messages? It cannot send again until you authorize it. This does not erase its access to the existing history of conversations it participates in.
linkedGames.conflict: Permission changed elsewhere. The current state has been loaded; retry your choice.
linkedGames.loadError: Could not load game application permissions. Try again.
linkedGames.saveError: Could not save the game application permission. Check the current state and try again.
linkedGames.registerConfirm: {{name}} will permanently become a game application. Sending personal messages will require recipient authorization. This type change cannot be undone and does not imply verified ownership.
linkedGames.registered: Game application; personal messaging requires recipient authorization.
